indicator_name: WGI: Control of Corruption, governance estimate (approx. -2.5 to +2.5), all economies
description: WGI: Контроль коррупции (оценка, от -2,5 до +2,5), страны мира
unit: governance estimate, standard normal units (approx. -2.5 to +2.5)
methodology: Worldwide Governance Indicators (Kaufmann-Kraay), Control of Corruption. Item = ISO3. Biennial 1996-2002 (1996, 1998, 2000), annual from 2002. Estimates are standardised each year across countries, so a level change partly reflects the other countries. WDI last updated 2026-03-18.
